notes.title: For Sava and Load BUG
notes.notes:
Recently, some players reported that the game could not be properly archived and read, and business people would card the gate. This is because the time zone parameter of the player's computer registry is empty. Please configure the parameters according to the following procedure:

Win+R  ->  Input “Regedit” to open Regedit。
Ctrl+F ->  Input \HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation
Find  【TimeZoneKeyName】，Right-click to change the value to 【China Standard Time】。
（Other time zones can be modified with reference to the values of each time zone.)

Once the configuration is complete, reopen the game.
You can check to see if the above problems have been solved.
We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused to you. 
We will study and fix this problem in the patch later if possible. 



近期有部分玩家反馈游戏无法正常存档读档，并且营业中小人会卡门口，这是因为玩家电脑注册表的时区参数为空导致的，请按照一下流程配置一下参数：
运行（找不到运行的话可以搜索“运行”）->输入Regedit
打开注册表之后，在地址栏输入：
计算机\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation
找到TimeZoneKeyName变量，右键将其值修改为China Standard Time
（其他时区可以参照各时区的取值修改）
配置完成之后，重新打开游戏即可。可以检查一下上述问题是否得到解决。
给各位造成不便深表歉意，后续我们会研究可以的话在补丁中修正这个问题，祝游戏愉快~
